notes.title: Feedback from La Game Cup and Leganda Update
notes.notes:
Recently, I submitted the game to an independent developers' competition, La Game Cup, including a game key so the jury could provide feedback on the project's status.

Here is the jury's response:

"The La Game Cup jury met this Monday to review all the submissions and unfortunately, the application for your game Leganda was not selected.

Despite the undeniable potential of the game highlighted by the jury, the main comment is that it is not yet sufficiently polished to be among the finalists of this edition.

We wish you continued success in developing this game and hope to see you among the candidates in the next edition!

Best of luck."

Overall, it is quite an encouraging comment with undeniable potential, which is nice to hear.

Initially planned for release in November 2024, I have decided, given these circumstances, to wait for the next edition in 2025. By then, the game will be more polished, in its final version, without early access, depending on the project's progress.

You'll need to be patient a little longer as I continue to improve the game, add new content, and polish all aspects. Unfortunately, I have also lost my graphic artist, who found a better-paying job. I completely understand and support their decision, but it means I will need to find another artist.

Thank you for your support and understanding. Your enthusiasm and feedback are invaluable to me. We continue to move forward, and I can't wait to share the final version of Leganda with you.

See you soon for more updates!

notes.title: An Update on Our Game Progress
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to share an update on our game's development! Currently in active development, we've reached a major milestone: 70% of the main gameplay is now completed. We're now focusing on refining the details and adding final elements to perfect the experience.

We're also excited to announce the addition of new music, immersive sound effects, and captivating atmospheres to the game. However, there are still a few aspects in this area that we're fine-tuning.

We'd like to express our gratitude to everyone who has supported this project and contributed to its enrichment every step of the way. Your enthusiasm and feedback are invaluable to us!

While we still have a few more months of work ahead, we're starting to see all of our great ideas come to life in the game. We can't wait to share it with you and see players dive in.

Thank you for your continued support, and see you soon!

notes.title: Message to Supporters: Game Development Update
notes.notes:
Dear friends and supporters,

First and foremost, I want to express my profound gratitude to each and every one of you for your ongoing support and enthusiasm for the game I am diligently working on. However, I must share a reality with you: I am not as present as I would like to be in regularly sharing updates and news about the project.

The reason is simple: my time and energy are fully dedicated to the development of the game. I am pouring my heart and soul into every line of code, every design detail, in order to deliver an exceptional gaming experience. Unfortunately, showcasing these advancements is not my strong suit.

Additionally, I recently launched a Kickstarter campaign to further support the development process. However, as I've mentioned before, visibility isn't my forte, and unfortunately, not many people have been able to find my project online. Nevertheless, I'm committed to pushing forward and making this game a reality.


Nevertheless, I want to assure you that the game is progressing at a steady pace and every day, I strive to make it better. Your unwavering support is an invaluable source of motivation for me, and I am immensely grateful for it.

To all those eagerly awaiting the game's release, I extend a heartfelt thank you. Your patience and anticipation strengthen my determination to make this project a reality that lives up to your expectations.

Once again, thank you from the bottom of my heart for your ongoing support and understanding.

Warm regards,
Steph.
